{{EventEnd|date = 22nd of September 2025}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = TheTakeover.png |dates = 12 September 2025 – 22 September 2025 |acts = 4 |act_name = Challenges |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:The Takeover|The Takeover]] |previous_event = [[Ducky Revenge Event|Ducky Revenge]] |next_event = [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]] }} ==Description== '''The Takeover Event''' was the twenty-third event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. This event was part of Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:The Takeover|The Takeover]] event, meaning players could gain [[w:c:roblox:The Takeover|The Takeover]] currency from it.
